# Quality measurement methods (generated by scripts/render_metric_methods.py)

Same input for all values: completion projection, 31,509 cases. `invalid` = token replay maps each label to one transition, not applicable with duplicated labels; `n/c` = not computable (unbounded net or unfinished alignment); HM token values vary by up to 0.03 between runs (docs/HEURISTICS_SWEEP.md).

| Criterion | Method | Implementation | IM | HM | IMf | Final | Advantage | Limitation | Use here |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness | Token-based replay | PM4Py fitness_token_based_replay | 1.000 | 0.833 | 0.987 | invalid | fast; local diagnostics (missing/remaining tokens) | non-deterministic with silent transitions; token flooding; invalid with duplicate labels | baseline comparison only |
| Fitness | Alignment-based | PM4Py formula; own exact aligner, PM4Py A* cross-check | 1.000 | n/c | 0.977 | 0.979 | optimal, deterministic cost; log/model moves as diagnostics | needs finite state space; HM run did not finish | reported fitness value |
| Fitness | Exact whole-case replay (%) | own, complete marking graph | 100.00 | <= 1.30 | 80.45 | 80.43 | directly 'share of cases represented' | binary per case; bounded nets only | constraint >= 80% |
| Precision | ETC (token-based) | PM4Py precision_token_based_replay | 0.293 | 0.998 | 0.595 | invalid | fast | inherits token-replay problems; invalid with duplicate labels | baseline comparison only |
| Precision | Align-ET (alignment-based) | PM4Py formula; own exact finite-state version, PM4Py cross-check | 0.293 | n/c | 0.598 | 0.695 | prefixes from optimal alignments; deterministic | misleading on non-fitting nets (HM) | optimisation target |
| Generalization | Token-based | PM4Py generalization_tbr | 0.976 | 0.861 | 0.991 | invalid | standard formula 1 - mean(1/sqrt(n_t)) | counts from token replay; invalid with duplicate labels | baseline comparison only |
| Generalization | Alignment-based counts | same formula, counts from optimal alignments | 0.976 | n/c | 0.991 | 0.988 | valid with duplicate labels | heuristic; tie-breaks between equal-cost alignments | guard rail (max. -0.01) |
| Simplicity | Arc degree | PM4Py simplicity_petri_net | 0.617 | 0.481 | 0.701 | 0.710 | normalised (higher = simpler) | ignores behaviour; flower model scores well | guard rail (max. -0.05) |
| Simplicity | Size (nodes) | own | 87 | 143 | 89 | 98 | intuitive | counts silent routing nodes | guard rail (max. +25%) |
| Simplicity | Extended Cardoso | own (Lassen and van der Aalst 2009) | 47 | 108 | 52 | 55 | counts distinct choices per place | structural only | reported |
| Simplicity | Extended Cyclomatic (ECyM) | own, complete marking graph | 1,552 | n/c | 551 | 166 | behavioural complexity of the state space | bounded nets only | reported |
